metadata.title: A high-velocity star recently ejected by an intermediate-mass black hole in M15

notes: J0731+3717 (Gaia DR3 898707303799931392) is not included: the paper calls it a high-velocity star ejected from M15 (T:p1-b11; T:p3-b6) and reports V_GSR = 418.71 km/s (T:p2-b0), but it does not explicitly state or establish that J0731+3717 is unbound from the Milky Way. The V_GSR ≥ 400 km/s cut is presented as selecting high-velocity halo stars (T:p10-b4), not as a Galactic-unbound criterion; the cluster-ejection interpretation alone therefore does not satisfy the required candidacy.
